item.description:
Notex 0.2.7
OpenRouter on managed networks OpenRouter summaries and note chat now connect through Notex. If your organization allows Notex's connection but blocks direct requests to model providers, you can use your own OpenRouter API key. OpenRouter bills inference to your key.
Choose models for summaries and chat Select an OpenRouter model separately for meeting summaries and note chat in Settings → AI Connections. Each feature also offers Auto, On Device, and OpenRouter processing choices. Model choices persist across launches, and compact menus show readable model names.
Clearer summary sections Generated meeting summaries have more space between section headings. Topic sections focus on context and findings instead of repeating decisions, action items, or open questions.
Cleaner recording options The transcript sidebar's options menu uses a compact borderless control.
Requires macOS 26 or later.

Notex 0.2.6
Recording that recovers after interruptions Recordings can now resume automatically when your display wakes or an audio source becomes available again. Your selected microphone and Reduce speaker echo setting are preserved. Paused recordings stay paused, and time spent interrupted is excluded from the recording duration. If capture cannot recover, Notex finishes saving the available audio and transcript.
Less background disk activity Interrupted recordings no longer repeatedly rewrite your library just to update recording diagnostics.
Summaries across recordings When a note contains several recordings, its summary now includes their combined transcripts. Summaries you have edited are preserved.
More representative titles and cleaner transcripts Automatic titles consider the full conversation, including topics discussed after the introduction. Punctuation-only transcription results no longer create empty-looking speaker rows.
Requires macOS 26 or later.

Notex 0.2.5
Cloud summaries for longer meetings You can now use GPT-5 Mini through OpenRouter. Open Settings → General → Manage Connections…, choose OpenRouter under Meeting summaries, and add your API key. The key is saved in Keychain on your Mac, and usage is billed to your OpenRouter account. Transcripts and the current note's text are sent to OpenRouter; audio stays on your Mac.
More reliable recording Improved audio saving with Bluetooth microphones and different input formats. Finishing a recording now has time limits so a stalled audio or transcription service cannot leave the recording stuck indefinitely. Available audio and transcript text are preserved when a step fails.
Optional speaker echo reduction Turn on Reduce speaker echo in Settings → Recording to use Apple's voice processing with supported microphones. It is off by default. Headphones remain the most reliable way to keep your voice separate from the other participants.
Faster editing and automatic titles Typing is more responsive, and new recordings can generate short, descriptive note and recording titles from their transcripts. Existing titles you have chosen are preserved.
Requires macOS 26 or later.
